projects.title: caffenated-redis
projects.description:
Github : https://github.com/seokkim95/caffeinated-redis

This library provides a two-level caching solution (L1: Local/Caffeine + L2: Global/Redis) designed for Spring Boot microservices. It reduces network latency and improves response times by serving frequently accessed data from local memory while maintaining consistency across distributed instances through Redis Pub/Sub.

projects.title: hey-you-write-my-email
projects.description:
Github : https://github.com/seokkim95/hey-you-write-my-emails

RAG-based AI email drafting agent built with Java 17, Spring Boot, Spring AI, and PostgreSQL (pgvector).
It ingests your Gmail history, generates embeddings, and stores them in a vector store to retrieve relevant past context for new incoming messages. When drafting replies, it combines the current thread context, similar past emails, and the latest business rules, always prioritizing up-to-date rules over historical content.
